_comment: 8e E1 (issue #16, the milestone's exit-criteria canonical) FIXTURE-FIRST start for pallass_walkthrough: an invrisil_attuned-era position with 'Papers for Pallass' NOT yet started (pallass_sponsored/pallass_attuned/pallass_entry_stamped/forge_permit_filed/grimalkin_examination_passed/elevator_pass_stamped all absent, started_quests empty). Extends the near_invrisil family (SAME door-chain + riverfarm + invrisil attunement chain -- door_awakened implies door_understood/recovered_anchor_stone/bought_catalyst/door_study_sleeps==3; invrisil_attuned implies blight_lifted + invrisil_attunement_stone in inventory; blight_lifted implies riverfarm_attuned -- test_fixture_coherence.gd's monotone arms enforce exactly this implication set, verbatim to near_invrisil.json's own derivation) but repositioned INSIDE the guild at Selys's own desk-approach cell (8,3) facing up -- the EXACT board_loop_start/near_guild precedent ('the street->guild walk is not the subject under test'): this canonical's subject is the Pallass QUALIFY route, not Liscor street pathing, so the fixture skips straight to Selys the same way board_loop_start skips straight to her desk. NOT locked to any combat-tuning band (unlike near_invrisil's own classes:{warrior:2}, pinned to the alley_footpads win-rate baseline) -- the whole Pallass route is a bureaucratic/travel chain with zero combat, so classes:{warrior:2} here is plain narrative plausibility only, freely re-tunable without a combat-harness re-measure. Deliberately OMITS post_game (and therefore the full Act-III backbone check) -- narratively this is a position BEFORE the deep-descent/Horns arc (8d), consistent with the roadmap's own 8b/8c-before-8d content order: a player who just banked invrisil_attuned and is about to chase the Pallass sponsorship has not necessarily cleared the Warrens yet. Also omits the crate/wrong-order early-Liscor flags (asked_about_crate/crate_returned/heard_wrong_order) -- matching door_chain_fight_start's own accepted precedent (that late-game fixture carries the SAME gap); Krshia's hub option 0 ('I'll look into it.') stays visible but unselected, the script simply skips past it via one cursor move, exactly as door_chain_fight.json's own script does. gold:60 covers the full documented chain (10+18+2+5+8+3=46g) with a 14g margin. rng_state reuses the repo's own canonical seed=9 derived value (the SAME literal every other seed-9 fixture carries) -- this route resolves zero combat, so seed stability is trivial and no fresh derivation was needed.
